hints.title: Group Synonyms into Connected Components
hints.text: Because synonymity is an equivalence relation, words connected through synonym pairs form connected components.

hints.title: Sort Equivalent Words Alphabetically
hints.text: For each distinct word group, sort all its members lexicographically so permutations generate in sorted order.

hints.title: Recursively Generate Sentence Combinations
hints.text: For each word in the source sentence, branch across all synonyms in its component to form complete sentences.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: S: total number of synonymous sentences generated
W: number of words in text
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Replacing synonyms randomly without transitive grouping misses valid equivalence chains.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Disjoint set union groups synonyms in near-linear time before generating ordered output.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize transitive equivalence and sort words inside each component.
complexity.notes: Final output list must be sorted lexicographically.
